result.rationale: The migration creates topic_embeds with a string embed_url (no :limit) plus a unique btree index on it; PostgreSQL btree indexes have a ~2704-byte row-size limit, so an extremely long embed_url would fail at INSERT rather than being caught by model validation (only presence is validated: validates_presence_of :embed_url). This is a concrete, diff-grounded limitation a maintainer should consider when shipping the schema.

adjudication.rationale: In the migration, `embed_url` is declared as `t.string :embed_url, null: false` (not `:text`). Under Rails conventions, `:string` maps to a bounded `varchar(255)` by default on PostgreSQL, not an unbounded varchar. So the stated PostgreSQL btree “index row size” failure mode for overly long URLs is not verifiable from this diff; the more likely DB-level failure would be exceeding the column length, not an index key size error.
